"""Front-door truthfulness helpers — receipt census and env documentation parity."""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from dipcatcher_cli.paths import repo_root

_ENV_LINE = re.compile(r"^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)\s*=")
_ENV_MENTION = re.compile(r"\b([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,})\b")
_TEST_ONLY_SECTION = "Test / audit-harness internals"


def receipt_census(root: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, int]:
    checkout = root or repo_root()
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(checkout), "ls-files", "receipts/"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )
    lines = [line.strip() for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    json_files = [p for p in lines if p.endswith(".json")]
    top_level = [p for p in json_files if p.count("/") == 1]
    legacy_unsealed = [p for p in json_files if p.startswith("receipts/legacy-unsealed/")]
    readme = sum(1 for p in lines if p.endswith("README.md"))
    return {
        "json_total": len(json_files),
        "json_top_level": len(top_level),
        "legacy_unsealed_json": len(legacy_unsealed),
        "readme_files": readme,
        "tracked_under_receipts": len(lines),
    }


def env_example_variables(path: Path | None = None) -> frozenset[str]:
    example = path or (repo_root() / ".env.example")
    names: set[str] = set()
    in_test_section = False
    for line in example.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if _TEST_ONLY_SECTION in line:
            in_test_section = True
        if in_test_section:
            continue
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        body = stripped.lstrip("#").strip() if stripped.startswith("#") else stripped
        match = _ENV_LINE.match(body)
        if match:
            names.add(match.group(1))
    return frozenset(names)


def env_example_all_variables(path: Path | None = None) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Every ``NAME=`` in ``.env.example``, including the test-only section."""
    example = path or (repo_root() / ".env.example")
    names: set[str] = set()
    for line in example.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        body = stripped.lstrip("#").strip() if stripped.startswith("#") else stripped
        match = _ENV_LINE.match(body)
        if match:
            names.add(match.group(1))
    return frozenset(names)

def _const_str(node: ast.AST) -> str | None:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
        return node.value
    return None


def source_environ_names(root: Path | None = None) -> frozenset[str]:
    """AST-scan ``src/`` for ``os.environ`` / ``os.getenv`` constant keys."""
    checkout = root or repo_root()
    collected = _collect_environ_names(checkout / "src")
    filtered = _filter_environ_names(collected)
    return frozenset(_sorted_environ_names(filtered))


def _sorted_environ_names(names: set[str]) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(names)


def _filter_environ_names(found: set[tuple[str, bool]]) -> set[str]:
    """Keep uppercase keys. Call-site hits must also be alphanumeric."""
    kept: set[str] = set()
    for key, require_alnum in found:
        if not key.isupper():
            continue
        if require_alnum and not key.replace("_", "").isalnum():
            continue
        kept.add(key)
    return kept


def _collect_environ_names(src: Path) -> set[tuple[str, bool]]:
    """``(key, require_alnum)`` hits. Calls require an alphanumeric key; subscripts do not."""
    found: set[tuple[str, bool]] = set()
    for path in src.rglob("*.py"):
        tree = _parse_module(path)
        if tree is None:
            continue
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            hit = _environ_hit(node)
            if hit is not None:
                found.add(hit)
    return found


def _parse_module(path: Path) -> ast.AST | None:
    try:
        return ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
    except (OSError, SyntaxError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return None


def _environ_hit(node: ast.AST) -> tuple[str, bool] | None:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _call_environ_hit(node)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Subscript):
        return _subscript_environ_hit(node)
    return None


def _call_environ_hit(node: ast.Call) -> tuple[str, bool] | None:
    if not node.args:
        return None
    key = _const_str(node.args[0])
    if key is None or not _is_environ_call(node):
        return None
    return (key, True)


def _is_environ_call(node: ast.Call) -> bool:
    func = node.func
    if isinstance(func, ast.Name):
        return func.id == "getenv"
    if not isinstance(func, ast.Attribute) or func.attr != "get":
        return False
    return _receiver_is_environ(func.value)


def _receiver_is_environ(value: ast.expr) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, ast.Name):
        return value.id in {"os", "environ"}
    if not isinstance(value, ast.Attribute):
        return False
    owner = value.value
    return isinstance(owner, ast.Name) and owner.id == "os" and value.attr == "environ"


def _subscript_environ_hit(node: ast.Subscript) -> tuple[str, bool] | None:
    key = _const_str(node.slice)
    if key is None or not _subscript_is_environ(node.value):
        return None
    return (key, False)


def _subscript_is_environ(target: ast.expr) -> bool:
    if isinstance(target, ast.Name):
        return target.id == "environ"
    if not isinstance(target, ast.Attribute):
        return False
    owner = target.value
    return isinstance(owner, ast.Name) and owner.id == "os" and target.attr == "environ"


def env_documentation_surfaces(root: Path | None = None) -> frozenset[str]:
    checkout = root or repo_root()
    surfaces = (checkout / ".env.example", checkout / "README.md", checkout / "AGENTS.md")
    mentioned: set[str] = set()
    for path in surfaces:
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        for token in _ENV_MENTION.findall(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
            mentioned.add(token)
    return frozenset(mentioned)
